fact.summary: The capability-scoped loader reads strict project intent, optional machine observations, and explicit manual evidence without following paths outside the repository-local directory.
On 2026-08-18, the self-map render contract loaded this repository's project evidence and evaluated it successfully.
Pure evaluation derives implementation, verification, display state, warnings, and deterministic focus selection from intent and observations.
On 2026-08-18, all eleven model contract tests passed, including state-sensitive focus language, inspectable machine-evidence enforcement, and rejection of an empty core journey.
The TUI renders the project promise, accepted core journey, supporting capabilities, and shared state-sensitive focus panel.
On 2026-08-18, the Recipe Box render contract and its reviewed snapshots passed at the supported terminal sizes, including reserved proof space under long evidence.
The inspector renders a separate accepted badge, Why, evidence summaries and locations, and Proof needed.
On 2026-08-18, compact and wide inspector assertions passed with Why, Evidence, Proof needed, and bounded evidence visible.
One current_focus interface owns the selected capability, state-specific heading, responsible explanation, next check, and positive completion result shared by CLI and TUI.
On 2026-08-15, subprocess contracts passed for the Recipe Box journey-break focus and the repository's positive completed-journey result.
The TUI runs inside Ratatui's managed terminal lifecycle for normal, error, and panic paths.
On 2026-08-18, all five PTY tests passed for real q and Ctrl-C exits plus injected success, error, and panic restoration.
The initializer uses a pinned capability-scoped directory handle and writes a commented three-step starter through an exclusive create-new path.
On 2026-08-18, subprocess tests proved that init creates a loadable all-unknown starter without machine evidence, preserves an existing map, and rejects an escaping config symlink.

The record command serializes concurrent writers, validates the project, supersedes only prior command-recorded facts in the same dimension, refuses unresolved conflicts, and atomically replaces its sidecar through a pinned directory handle.

On 2026-08-18, subprocess tests proved safe recording, unchanged project intent, stale-history preservation, unknown-node rejection, conflict refusal, and preservation of two concurrent process results.
